title: Three months, and the last two weeks are interviews, not new problems
takeaway: Build patterns in months 1 and 2, then shift from studying to performing under a 45-minute timer.
sources: Data structures and algorithms are not facts to memorize.
Month 3 is not about learning new material.
This is the most important part of the plan.
This plan requires 1-1.5 hours per day, 6 days per week.

events.label: Foundations
events.note: Arrays, hash maps, linked lists, stacks, trees

events.label: Intermediate patterns
events.note: Binary search, graphs, heaps, DP foundations

events.label: Advanced topics and weak areas
events.note: Audit months 1 and 2, drill what you struggled with

events.label: Mock interviews and simulation
events.note: At least 10 full simulations, 45-minute timer, out loud
